C1.1.text: at the D-117 selected layer L* (selected C, item level, D-156 mean [95% band over 1000 re-partitions]) the frozen threshold's paired ratio FPR_post/FPR_pre lies between 1.58 (Qwen2.5) and 17.38 (Mistral-7B v0.1) over the nine released pairs, against 1.01 [0.89, 1.19] for the v0.1 -> v0.2 control (Table I). C1.2.text: the realised rate can also fall far below target: the headline cell that shows it is Phase 2 cell 2a (Mistral-7B-Instruct v0.1 -> v0.2, WildGuardMix, L* = 16, C = 0.003), paired ratio 0.055 [0.025, 0.086] (D-156 mean [band]; the low side of D-241 (3)'s two-fold rule, <= 0.5). No all-layer range is stated.

C1.5.text: on Llama-3-8B -> Llama-3.1-8B the minimum CKA over layers reads 0.99302 while the frozen threshold's paired ratio at L* = 14 is 3.22 [2.46, 4.71] (Table I; selected C, item level, D-156).

C1.6.retire: the frozen-split counts are dropped; C1.8's D-156 result carries the point: the AUC rule's pooled sensitivity on the released pairs is 0.019 [0.000, 0.040] (two-sided x2 class, pair-cluster interval)

C1.7.text: in the LoRA AUC-rule audit the GPU-change control contributes zero calibration failures at either threshold (ledger row #12 HELD, D-102's negative check; frozen split, D-103; in the record the six LoRA runs' failures sum to the audit's total at both thresholds). C1.10.text: AUROC drop and threshold damage show no firm cell-level link under D-156 (selected C, item level): at the pair level (n = 10; sweep-maximum paired ratio against the maximum AUROC drop, D-190) Spearman 0.430 (0.400 on the five unflagged pairs), no interval computed; at the layer level (156 cells of nine pairs) Spearman +0.373 [-0.167, +0.669] (pair-cluster bootstrap), an interval that includes 0 (D-196).

C1.15.text: refusals of XSTest's safe prompts rise sharply at mid-depth: on Mistral-7B v0.1 -> Instruct at L16 the paired refusal ratio is 9.43 [7.52, 12.42], the share of the 250 safe prompts flagged moving from 0.053 to 0.480 (selected C, item level, D-156 mean [band over the Aegis re-partitions; XSTest is fixed]; Fig. 5's record).

C1.18.text: Mistral v0.1 -> v0.2 moves XSTest refusals at early and late layers: the paired refusal ratio's band lies above 1 at L2 3.328 [2.609, 4.337], L4 1.353 [1.245, 1.450], L6 1.111 [1.040, 1.191] and L18 1.122 [1.030, 1.207] (D-253; selected C, item level, D-156), while at the mid layer L16 it is 1.000 [0.922, 1.096]. Hardware is ruled out at those four layers: Mistral-7B-v0.1's largest V100-A100 difference in the share of safe prompts flagged is 0.000136 over 17 layers against the 0.001 bound (D-267, D-258 (4)).

C1.20.text: delta TPR (post - pre) at the frozen threshold per stratum, the frozen split's value with the D-282 combined 95% interval (selected C, item level; D-304's cells): WildGuardMix Mistral-7B v0.1 L32: adversarial -0.2080 [-0.2433, -0.1895], vanilla -0.1538 [-0.1703, -0.1248]; adversarial minus vanilla -0.0542 [-0.1093, -0.0308] at 1% and -0.1409 [-0.1679, -0.1088] at 5%; WildGuardMix Llama-3 L28: adversarial -0.1152 [-0.1437, -0.1038], vanilla -0.1784 [-0.1904, -0.1360]; adversarial minus vanilla +0.0633 [+0.0020, +0.0754] at 1% and -0.0226 [-0.0481, -0.0025] at 5%. The contrast's interval excludes 0 in both cells at both rates; on Mistral it is negative at both, on Llama-3 its sign flips between 1% and 5%, so no general adversarial asymmetry is claimed (D-304).

C1.21.text: at L* the WildGuardMix Mistral arm's paired ratio is 9.52 [6.03, 16.58] (L14) where the Aegis arm's is 17.38 [10.20, 32.88] (L12) (Table I; selected C, item level, D-156). Repeating the repair on WildGuardMix reproduces it (D-285, 4d B, two WildGuardMix pairs).

C2.1.text: re-estimating the representation mean alone (mean_only) accounts for 0.763 [0.640, 0.914] of the improvement restandardisation makes at L* (ratio of pooled means over the seven Aegis pairs, pair-cluster bootstrap), beside that improvement, frozen minus restandardise in |log(FPR/target)|, 0.922 [0.484, 1.426]; per pair the share is undefined in 5 of 7 (ledger row #42 UNDEFINED). Reported beside the improvement, never as a percentage (D-089).
C2.1.deviation: the sheet's option A names D-247's 0.716 [0.653, 0.948] (results/moment_contrasts_d156.json, the D-235 record, unflagged row), which D-267 supersedes in its primary metric (D-257 (1): the D-117 layer); the current record's L* value is applied by D-496 (5)

C2.2.text: a paired alignment map calibrates worse than no repair in 0 of 7 pairs at L* (D-267); the draft's '4 of 7' is withdrawn (ledger row #41 FAILED). Pooled over the seven Aegis pairs (pair-cluster bootstrap, |log(FPR/target)|), paired_align minus frozen is -0.883 [-1.493, -0.361] and restandardise minus paired_align -0.039 [-0.141, +0.075].

C2.3.text: the alignment variants under D-156 (mean over layers of |log(FPR/target)|, selected C, item level, D-156 means; D-249, descriptive: no contrast was registered): the ridge map lies at 0.302-0.427 against a no-update floor of 0.272-0.289; Procrustes 0.303-0.815; CORAL 0.273-1.293, worse than no repair in OLMo-2 (1.223 against a frozen 0.631), and CORAL loses discrimination: its AUROC drop at L* has an interval excluding 0 in 6 of 7 pairs (+0.005 to +0.092). Registered rows on the frozen-split alignvar records (D-093, D-094): #14 FAILED, #15 HELD, #16 NOT SUPPORTED.
C2.3.status_reason: STATUS DESCRIPTIVE, a DEVIATION from D-496 (5)'s list (RETIRED, SUPPORTED, FLAGGED, AUTHOR DECISION PENDING): D-460 (1)(f) defines DESCRIPTIVE for numbers read from a committed record that no registered prediction scores, which D-249's are (D-218, D-229 registered no contrast); rows #14-#16 are reported beside as registered verdicts on the frozen-split records

C2.5.text: we describe the failure as a moment shift: a correction of the first and second moments (restandardisation) restores the operating point to within calibration resolution (D-271 (4)): at L* it is at floor in 7 of 7 pairs, pooled restandardise minus floor +0.016 [-0.030, +0.092] (D-267).

C3.2.text: worst-case realised FPR (Table III: the sweep maximum of the per-layer mean FPR/target, D-156) shows the same ordering at 25/100/400 steps: general (alpaca) 1.60/1.44/1.58 against PKU-SafeRLHF 21.33/10.49/12.27 and HH-RLHF 34.34/12.30/12.08 (HH marked under check, D-349); the general arm is below both safety arms at every dose. Damage does not grow monotonically with dose: the frozen error and the worst FPR/target are largest at 25 steps in every arm, and the registered dose prediction (H-LoRA-1, monotone non-decreasing over 25 < 100 < 400; ledger row #3, frozen-split records) is NOT SUPPORTED.
C3.2.pending: decision H (whether the HH rows enter; held by the author, C3.1c)

C3.7.text: within the controlled Mistral-7B-v0.1 LoRA arms, the safety-oriented updates decalibrate the frozen monitor more than the general one at matched dose, and the standard health check (the AUC rule) does not say so. The claim is scoped to these arms; PKU-SafeRLHF is the clean safety arm (D-357 (B)(4)) and the HH arm enters as decision H rules.
C3.7.pending: decision H (its safety arms and the AUC-rule half's pooled LoRA rows include the HH arm)

C4.1.text: label-free restandardisation (the post-update features standardised with the post model's mean and SD; probe weights and threshold untouched) restores the operating point only with a class-matched reference: on the probe's class-balanced training rows (4d A) it gives FPR/target 1.01 to 1.71 at L* across the nine pairs (Table II), at floor in 7 of 7 Aegis pairs, pooled restandardise minus frozen -0.922 [-1.426, -0.484] in |log(FPR/target)| (D-267); on 1% live traffic (a pool of 1000 prompts at 1% prevalence) it overshoots, FPR/target 4.74 to 9.82 (Aegis) and 21.87 / 24.36 (WildGuardMix Mistral / Llama-3) (D-322).

C4.2.text: against the no-update floor (D-257's paired floor test at L*), restandardisation is at floor in 7 of 7 pairs, pooled +0.016 [-0.030, +0.092] above floor (+0.039 [+0.008, +0.087] on the mean over layers, a small pooled excess no single pair shows); it is restored to within calibration resolution (D-267, D-271 (4)).

C4.3.text: on the non-parametric retrieval (similarity) layer the z-score correction does not transfer: on Qwen2.5 it drives the realised FPR to zero, FPR/target at its floor 0.05 with its whole 95% band at the floor (so in at least 95% of draws) at 6 of 15 layers (L8, L10, L12, L18, L20, L26) and a mean of at most 0.172 at L4-L26, with TPR 0.000 to 0.003 there; on Mistral it overshoots, FPR/target 3.29 to 55.04 at L2-L32 (D-266; item level, D-156 means). Repairs do not transfer across layer types. The quantile-transfer arm carries the F-070 bias and is not reported (D-245).

C4.8.text: labelled an inference from C4.3: 'A single recalibration recipe applied across a heterogeneous stack would therefore silence one of its layers.'
C4.8.condition: met: D-266's Qwen2.5 record holds the zero-FPR z-score result (FPR/target's whole 95% band at the floor at 6 of 15 layers; TPR 0.000-0.003 at L4-L26); on Mistral the same arm overshoots instead (3.29-55.04 at L2-L32), so the silencing holds for Qwen2.5's layer (values as C4.3's, read there)

C5.1.text: a label-free check on reference prompts (the Gaussian health ratio, 4c) flags threshold failures the AUC rule misses: over the nine released pairs (156 layer cells; selected C, item level, two-sided x2 class) sensitivity 0.918 and specificity 0.898, point estimates from the D-156 mean counts with no interval (D-476 (5)); per pair, damaged cells flagged of damaged and undamaged cells flagged of undamaged (D-156 mean counts per draw): Mistral-7B v0.1 15.98 of 15.98, 0.02 of 1.02; Gemma-2 17.00 of 17.09, 0.00 of 4.91; Llama-3 9.57 of 10.85, 0.31 of 6.15; Llama-3.1 9.65 of 12.30, 0.93 of 4.70; Qwen2.5 1.00 of 3.23, 0.00 of 11.77; OLMo-2 6.53 of 7.08, 0.10 of 9.92; Llama-3 -> 3.1 14.00 of 14.00, 2.00 of 3.00; Mistral-7B v0.1 (WGM) 16.00 of 16.00, 0.00 of 1.00; Llama-3 (WGM) 4.83 of 6.50, 2.01 of 10.50. The AUC rule's sensitivity is 0.019. ROC AUC 0.952 sits beside; no ranking claim is made (P-C5.2 FAILED, C5.3).

C5.2.text: LoRA rows of the health check (Table IV; selected C, item level, two-sided x2): all nine runs sensitivity 0.959 / specificity 0.988; general (alpaca) sensitivity 0.111 on 1.70 damaged cells per draw; safety (six runs, HH-RLHF and PKU-SafeRLHF) 0.975 / 0.987. Beside (D-380, the D-363 removal set): the six safety runs' specificity falls to 0.784 on the reduced items.
C5.2.pending: decision H (all nine runs include the three HH runs; held by the author, C3.1c)

C5.3.text: the Gaussian health ratio beats the stronger label-free baselines (KS and ATC) on the flag, not on ranking: no baseline has both pooled sensitivity and specificity at or above it (P-C5.3 HELD: KS 0.966/0.543, ATC 0.479/0.982, Gaussian 0.918/0.898; P-C5.1 HELD), while ATC ranks better (P-C5.2 FAILED: ROC AUC 0.965 against 0.952).

C6.2.text: A1's by-c heavy-tail check is NOT SUPPORTED as registered (D-370 (4) needs all four parts): (a) 1,301 of the Gaussian detector's 1,302 pooled false alarms fall at c < 0, (b) at c < 0 the direct detector's false-alarm rate 0.180 is below the Gaussian's 0.433, and (c) tau > 0 in 8 of 9 pairs, all hold; (d) the Spearman correlation across the nine pairs between tau and the mean log(realised/predicted) at c < 0 is -0.367, which fails. Beside, not a verdict: (d)'s quantity is dominated by the 1/|E| floor (D-374 (1), D-375). Ledger rows #63 HELD, #64 HELD, #65 HELD, #66 FAILED, #67 NOT SUPPORTED.

C6.8.text: we did not run an adaptive attacker: no attacker adapted to the probe, the health check or the canaries (D-451 states the unrun arms as limitations and names an adaptive canary attacker as the first to run if reviewers ask). A2 shows that a topic-targeted update can succeed on one category under the registered rule with stealthy cells (C6.7); nothing here establishes that an adversary can time an update window. Every prompt in this study was fixed in advance.

C1.24.text: a cell is censored when its realised FPR at the frozen threshold is zero, 0 of the n evaluation negatives, so |log(FPR/target)| is undefined; it is floored at the resolution 1/n (D-089; D-156 keeps this floor). Under this rule exactly one censored cell exists anywhere in the frozen-split records (the alpaca LoRA run at 100 steps): the 45 censored-cell counts of results/synthesis2.json sum to 1. The alternative treatments' ranges are not stated.
C1.24.flag_reason: the count is on the frozen split (synthesis2.json, pre-D-156); the D-156 records carry each cell's realised_censoring (share_of_draws_floored, frozen_split_floored), not counted here (D-496 (6))

pr7.text: on the 9 Phase 2 pairs (63 headline cells; user-span mean, selected C, item level, 1%) the two-moment model (moment_full_in_sample: the post-update moments of the same evaluation negatives) accounts for the realised paired ratio: slope 0.911 [0.806, 1.292] (pair-cluster bootstrap, includes 1; P2-M.1 HELD); share within x1.5 0.905 of the 63 cells, median |log error| 0.058 (P2-M.2 HELD); share within x1.5 for two moments 0.905 against translation 0.730 (P2-M.3 HELD). With all three HELD, the Phase 2 gate (D-361 (5)) is met.

realignment (a ridge (D-418) or orthogonal Procrustes (D-423) map of the post-update features onto the pre-update ones, fitted on a reference pool (R_same, R_fresh, 1% traffic)) keeps AUROC by Duan's criterion (P-RA.1): Phase 1 ridge 27 of 27 cells (HELD, #105); Phase 2 ridge 27 of 27 cells (HELD, #109); LoRA ridge 27 of 27 cells (HELD, #113); Phase 1 Procrustes 27 of 27 cells (HELD, #117); Phase 2 Procrustes 27 of 27 cells (HELD, #121); LoRA Procrustes 27 of 27 cells (HELD, #125).

realignment fitted on the stored reference R_same was predicted to leave the frozen threshold's FPR/target outside x1.5 in at least 6 of the 9 pairs (P-RA.2, D-418 (5)'s rule): Phase 1 ridge 9 of 9 pairs (HELD, #106); Phase 2 ridge 9 of 9 pairs (HELD, #110); LoRA ridge 9 of 9 pairs (HELD, #114); Phase 1 Procrustes 6 of 9 pairs (HELD, #118); Phase 2 Procrustes 4 of 9 pairs (FAILED, #122); LoRA Procrustes 3 of 9 pairs (FAILED, #126).

after realignment the two-moment model (moment_full_in_sample) was predicted to give the realised FPR/target within x1.5 in at least 80% of the cells (P-RA.3, D-418 (5)'s rule, with the D-177 line): Phase 1 ridge share within x1.5 0.556 of the 27 cells, median 0.285 (FAILED, #107); Phase 2 ridge share within x1.5 0.630 of the 27 cells, median 0.261 (FAILED, #111); LoRA ridge share within x1.5 1.000 of the 27 cells, median 0.236 (HELD, #115); Phase 1 Procrustes share within x1.5 1.000 of the 27 cells, median 0.070 (HELD, #119); Phase 2 Procrustes share within x1.5 1.000 of the 27 cells, median 0.021 (HELD, #123); LoRA Procrustes share within x1.5 1.000 of the 27 cells, median 0.057 (HELD, #127).

A1's poisoning sets were predicted to move the realigned FPR by x2 at some rho <= 1% in at least 80% of the cells (P-RA.4, D-418 (5)'s rule); they do not: Phase 1 ridge 0 of 27 cells moved x2 (FAILED, #108); Phase 2 ridge 5 of 27 cells moved x2 (FAILED, #112); LoRA ridge 0 of 27 cells moved x2 (FAILED, #116); Phase 1 Procrustes 0 of 27 cells moved x2 (FAILED, #120); Phase 2 Procrustes 0 of 27 cells moved x2 (FAILED, #124); LoRA Procrustes 0 of 27 cells moved x2 (FAILED, #128).

a one-hidden-layer MLP probe in place of the linear probe shows the same damage: the frozen paired ratio is >= 2 in 7 of 9 released pairs (linear 8; P-MLP.1 HELD), its Table I paired ratios within x1.5 of the linear probe's with share 1.000 of the 9 pairs (median |log| 0.085); |delta AUROC| < 0.05 in 9 pairs (linear 9; P-MLP.3 HELD; largest 0.0079, D-419 (5)). A post-exit supplement; it cannot reopen Phase 1 (D-401 (b)).
for the MLP probe the R_same threshold repair's FPR/target (D-156 mean) lies in (0.5, 2) in 9 of 9 pairs (linear 9; P-MLP.2 HELD).
for the MLP probe the Gaussian health ratio's pooled sensitivity for the primary class over the nine L* cells is 0.807, at or above 0.8 (P-MLP.4 HELD; linear 0.860).
